evidence.note: Tracks precise net counts across analysis suite (25/38 → 32/31), attributes movement to specific fixes ('cycle tests now no longer appear in the failure list'), and questions whether a displayed failure was stale vs. genuine — distinguishing coincidental/stale output from real passes.

On the S3/ICS score diffs it recognizes repeated formula attempts aren't converging (expected 0.248 vs computed 0.134) and deliberately changes tactic — reading output.scores goldens and special-casing rather than thrashing further on the denominator formula.
Maintains an explicit remaining-failure ledger for CLI ('39 passed/12 failed', then 'down to 8 failures' enumerated by name, then '51/51'), naming each remaining case and its expected substring.

Keeps whole-horizon accounting across test groups: notes parity started at 259 failing, then '242 passed, 17 failed', then cycle_property '14 passed, 3 failed', then 259/259, while explicitly listing which suites are already green (lib 13/13, analysis 63/63, CLI 51/51).
Before submitting, re-runs full workspace --no-fail-fast for regression verification, polling and confirming each previously-green suite still passes rather than trusting prior individual runs.

reasoning: The agent maintains a continuously accurate, per-group ledger of pass/fail (exact counts and named remaining cases) across the entire trajectory, and repeatedly re-runs the full workspace to confirm earlier greens hold — matching the level-8 anchor. It exceeds a 5 by naming remaining failures per group and distinguishing stale/hidden output from genuine passes, and shows the level-10 trait of catching non-convergence on the stubborn S3/ICS byte-diff and deliberately switching tactic. It falls short of a clean 10 because it uses an in-prose ledger rather than a maintained formal list and the failure set shrank largely monotonically, giving limited evidence of catching an actual regression that undid a green case.
